name: working-bee
description: Claude Code plugins for working solo like a team: guardrails, project memory, bootstrap, subagents and orchestration.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Guardrails for git, shell and secret files, a session brief and git context that survives compaction.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Project memory that improves with use: /learn turns a mistake into a rule, /gotcha records a surprise, /agents-md keeps AGENTS.md accurate.

plugins.name: python-backend
plugins.description: The Python hat: ruff fixes and formats every Python file Claude edits; /test runs pytest with the project's own runner.

plugins.name: privacy
plugins.description: Asks before sensitive terms or personal data (e-mails, phones, CPF, addresses, internal hosts) leave through files, commits, pushes or published text.

plugins.name: bootstrap
plugins.description: /bootstrap prepares a repository in one pass: marketplace and plugins in .claude/settings.json, safe permissions, AGENTS.md, gotchas, PR template, privacy pre-commit.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: A team for one: specialist reviewers run in parallel and an adversarial pass refutes what is not real (/review).
